description: This PHP source file appears to be part of the vtiger CRM system and handles the process of duplicating, merging, and related record management within modules, specifically managing duplication merges and related record transfers.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine wrapper class used for rendering the UI components for record merging and duplication processes.

methods.name: transferRelatedRecords
methods.description: Transfers related records from a set of source records to a target record during merge operations.

methods.name: DeleteEntity
methods.description: Deletes a record entity in the specified module.

methods.name: getRecordValues
methods.description: Retrieves all relevant field values for a set of record IDs within a module.
